harness_definition_id.description: The atomic-harness-definition ID from the compiled Builder contract.

category_id.description: The governed category this harness belongs to.

grammar_family.description: The grammar family resolved from the category_id.

wrong_reading_locks.description: The harness's wrong-reading locks to translate into spatial constraints.

slide_index.description: Zero-indexed position of this slide in the carousel sequence. Always 0 for supervisuals.

slide_role.description: The structural role this slide plays in the sequence. Dynamically validated against taxonomy_bindings.json.

specimen_ref.description: Provenance reference to the visual specimen this slide was analyzed from.

semantic_role.description: What this element means: headline, caption, creator_attribution, evidence_photo, etc.

observed_height_pct.description: Measured height as percentage of canvas from specimen analysis.

observed_width_pct.description: Measured width as percentage of canvas from specimen analysis.

observed_y_anchor_pct.description: Measured vertical start position as percentage of canvas.

observed_font_size_px.description: Estimated font size in pixels from specimen. Text primitives only.

overlap_observed.description: Whether this element intentionally overlaps another in the specimen.

cross_slide_stable.description: Whether this element appears in the same position across multiple slides.

observed_primitives.description: Primitives observed in this slide from specimen analysis.

slide_evidence.description: Per-slide evidence from specimen analysis. One entry per slide in sequence.

canvas_dimensions.description: Target canvas dimensions for normalized coordinate computation.

activative_input_refs.description: Immutable semantic lineage refs from the harness. Reference-only, never mutated.
